post.caption: Two huge diamonds are called chips. They were cut from the largest gem-quality rough diamond ever found, and Asscher of Amsterdam took about eight months to cut nine large stones. The two largest sit in the Sovereign's Sceptre and Imperial State Crown. Cullinan III is a pear shape of about 94 carats and Cullinan IV is a square cushion of about 64 carats. South Africa's government gave them to Queen Mary in 1910, and they became a brooch around 1911 that can be worn apart. Queen Elizabeth II inherited it from her grandmother in 1953 and reportedly joked about Granny's Chips. Together the two stones weigh about 158 carats.
